A batch of simulated games

Source: R/classes.R
dp_sim.Rd

A dp_sim collects the outcomes of many games played by bots. dp_simulate() returns one; dp_stats() and the dp_plot_* functions summarise it.

Details

games

One row per game: game, outcome, winner, years, turns.

centres

Final supply-centre and unit counts, one row per game and power.

contests

How often a standoff occurred in each province.

settings

The arguments the simulation was run with.

See also

dp_simulate(), dp_stats(), is_dp_sim()

Other simulation: dp_simulate(), dp_stats(), is_dp_sim()

Examples

sim <- dp_simulate(n = 1, bots = "hold", max_years = 2, verbose = FALSE)
sim$games
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>    game outcome winner years turns
#>   <int> <chr>   <chr>  <int> <int>
#> 1     1 draw    NA         3     6
